dataset_description: This is the repository's processed version of the Web Page Phishing Detection dataset by Abdelhakim Hannousse and Salima Yahiouche (Mendeley Data version 2, DOI 10.17632/c2gw7fy2j4.2), associated with the paper "Towards Benchmark Datasets for Machine Learning Based Website Phishing Detection: An Experimental Study" (paper DOI 10.1016/j.engappai.2021.104347). The source was constructed in May 2020 from legitimate URLs collected through Alexa- and Yandex-derived sources and phishing URLs from PhishTank and OpenPhish. It was designed as a benchmark combining URL structure and syntax, fetched-page HTML content, and third-party service information. This processed table has 11,430 rows and 87 columns: 86 predictors and the categorical target status. It is exactly balanced, with 5,715 legitimate and 5,715 phishing rows, and contains no missing values. Repository preprocessing removes the source URL index because it is almost unique and removes submit_email because SDV inferred it as an email/PII-like field. The retained predictors comprise 56 URL-based features, 23 page-content features, and 7 external-service features. Important encoding details inherited from the authors' extraction scripts are that https_token equals 0 for HTTPS and 1 otherwise; whois_registered_domain, dns_record, google_index, and domain_in_title also use 0 for the favorable or present condition and 1 for the absent or failed condition; links_in_tags, ratio_intMedia, ratio_extMedia, and safe_anchor are percentages on a 0-to-100 scale; safe_anchor is named counterintuitively and records the percentage of unsafe anchors. Internal, external, and null hyperlink ratios sum to either 1 when hyperlinks exist or 0 when none exist. Internal and external media percentages similarly sum to approximately 100 when media links exist or 0 when none exist. Some source-extraction features are constant in this processed table: nb_or, ratio_nullHyperlinks, ratio_intRedirection, ratio_intErrors, and sfh are all zero.

column_descriptions.length_url: Number of characters in the complete URL string.
column_descriptions.length_hostname: Number of characters in the parsed hostname. Because the hostname is part of the complete URL, this value does not exceed length_url.
column_descriptions.ip: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the URL matches an IPv4, hexadecimal IPv4, IPv6, or related IP-address pattern and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.nb_dots: Number of period characters (.) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_hyphens: Number of hyphen characters (-) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_at: Number of at-sign characters (@) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_qm: Number of question-mark characters (?) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_and: Number of ampersand characters (&) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_or: Number of vertical-bar characters (|) in the complete URL. This feature is zero for every row in the processed table.
column_descriptions.nb_eq: Number of equals-sign characters (=) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_underscore: Number of underscore characters (_) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_tilde: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the complete URL contains at least one tilde character (~) and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.nb_percent: Number of percent-sign characters (%) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_slash: Number of forward-slash characters (/) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_star: Number of asterisk characters (*) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_colon: Number of colon characters (:) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_comma: Number of comma characters (,) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_semicolumn: Number of semicolon characters (;) in the complete URL. The misspelling 'semicolumn' is inherited from the source schema.
column_descriptions.nb_dollar: Number of dollar-sign characters ($) in the complete URL.
column_descriptions.nb_space: Number of literal spaces plus occurrences of the URL-encoded space token %20 in the complete URL; each literal space or %20 token contributes one to this feature.
column_descriptions.nb_www: Number of URL word tokens that contain the substring 'www'.
column_descriptions.nb_com: Number of URL word tokens that contain the substring 'com'.
column_descriptions.nb_dslash: Binary indicator equal to 1 when a double slash (//) occurs after the initial scheme delimiter and 0 otherwise; despite the 'nb' prefix, the source extractor stores an indicator rather than a count.
column_descriptions.http_in_path: Number of occurrences of the substring 'http' in the parsed URL path.
column_descriptions.https_token: Non-HTTPS indicator from the source extractor: 0 when the parsed URL scheme is https and 1 for every other scheme.
column_descriptions.ratio_digits_url: Fraction of all characters in the complete URL that are decimal digits, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.ratio_digits_host: Fraction of all characters in the parsed hostname that are decimal digits, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.punycode: Binary indicator from the source extractor for a URL beginning with the HTTP Punycode prefix http://xn--; 1 indicates a match and 0 indicates no match.
column_descriptions.port: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the URL contains an explicit numeric port after the hostname and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.tld_in_path: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the URL's top-level-domain string also occurs in its path and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.tld_in_subdomain: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the URL's top-level-domain string occurs in its subdomain and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.abnormal_subdomain: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the URL contains an abnormal www-like subdomain matching the source extractor's w[w]?[0-9]* pattern and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.nb_subdomains: Capped domain-depth encoding produced from the URL's period count: 1 for one period, 2 for two periods, and 3 for the source extractor's catch-all multiple-depth case.
column_descriptions.prefix_suffix: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the hostname uses a hyphen-separated prefix/suffix pattern and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.random_domain: Binary output of the source natural-language heuristic for whether the registered domain appears to be composed of random rather than word-like characters.
column_descriptions.shortening_service: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the URL matches a known URL-shortening service in the source extractor's list and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.path_extension: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the parsed path ends in .txt and 0 otherwise, following the supplied extraction implementation.
column_descriptions.nb_redirection: Number of HTTP redirects in the fetched page response history.
column_descriptions.nb_external_redirection: Number of redirects in the fetched response history whose destination uses a different registered domain. These redirects are a subset of nb_redirection.
column_descriptions.length_words_raw: Number of nonempty raw URL word tokens obtained by splitting the registered-domain label, subdomain, and path on common URL delimiters.
column_descriptions.char_repeat: Total count of overlapping repeated-character windows of lengths 2, 3, 4, and 5 across the raw URL word tokens.
column_descriptions.shortest_words_raw: Character length of the shortest nonempty token across the registered-domain label, subdomain, and path.
column_descriptions.shortest_word_host: Character length of the shortest nonempty token in the registered-domain label and subdomain.
column_descriptions.shortest_word_path: Character length of the shortest nonempty path token; 0 when the path supplies no token.
column_descriptions.longest_words_raw: Character length of the longest nonempty token across the registered-domain label, subdomain, and path.
column_descriptions.longest_word_host: Character length of the longest nonempty token in the registered-domain label and subdomain.
column_descriptions.longest_word_path: Character length of the longest nonempty path token; 0 when the path supplies no token.
column_descriptions.avg_words_raw: Mean character length of the nonempty tokens across the registered-domain label, subdomain, and path.
column_descriptions.avg_word_host: Mean character length of nonempty tokens in the registered-domain label and subdomain.
column_descriptions.avg_word_path: Mean character length of nonempty path tokens; 0 when the path supplies no token.
column_descriptions.phish_hints: Total number of occurrences in the URL of terms from the source extractor's phishing-hint list, such as login, account, admin, signin, and related sensitive terms.
column_descriptions.domain_in_brand: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the URL's registered-domain label is present in the source list of known brand names and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.brand_in_subdomain: Binary indicator equal to 1 when a known brand name other than the URL's own domain appears in the subdomain and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.brand_in_path: Binary indicator equal to 1 when a known brand name other than the URL's own domain appears in the path and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.suspecious_tld: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the top-level domain belongs to the source extractor's suspicious-TLD list and 0 otherwise. The misspelling 'suspecious' is inherited from the source schema.
column_descriptions.statistical_report: Result of matching the URL domain or resolved IP against source lists of frequently abused domains and phishing-associated IP addresses: 1 for a suspicious match, 0 for no match, and 2 when the DNS/IP lookup fails.
column_descriptions.nb_hyperlinks: Total number of hyperlinks and linked resources extracted from the fetched page's href and src attributes.
column_descriptions.ratio_intHyperlinks: Fraction of extracted page hyperlinks and linked resources classified as internal to the page's registered domain, on a 0-to-1 scale; 0 when no hyperlinks exist.
column_descriptions.ratio_extHyperlinks: Fraction of extracted page hyperlinks and linked resources classified as external to the page's registered domain, on a 0-to-1 scale; 0 when no hyperlinks exist.
column_descriptions.ratio_nullHyperlinks: Fraction of extracted page hyperlinks with null or empty destinations, on a 0-to-1 scale. This feature is zero for every row in the processed table.
column_descriptions.nb_extCSS: Number of external cascading-style-sheet links extracted from the fetched page.
column_descriptions.ratio_intRedirection: Number of detected redirects among internal page links divided by the number of internal links; 0 when no internal links exist. This feature is zero for every row in the processed table.
column_descriptions.ratio_extRedirection: Number of detected redirect responses among external page links divided by the number of external links; 0 when no external links exist. Because one link can contribute multiple response-history redirects in the supplied extractor, values can exceed 1.
column_descriptions.ratio_intErrors: Fraction of internal page links that produced a connection error; 0 when no internal links exist. This feature is zero for every row in the processed table.
column_descriptions.ratio_extErrors: Fraction of external page links that produced a connection error, on a 0-to-1 scale; 0 when no external links exist.
column_descriptions.login_form: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the page contains a form with an external or null action, or an action matching the source extractor's suspicious PHP pattern, and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.external_favicon: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the page's favicon is loaded from an external domain and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.links_in_tags: Percentage of URLs in HTML link tags that are internal to the page's registered domain, on a 0-to-100 scale; 0 when no such links exist.
column_descriptions.ratio_intMedia: Percentage of extracted image, audio, and video resource links that are internal to the page's registered domain, on a 0-to-100 scale; 0 when no media links exist.
column_descriptions.ratio_extMedia: Percentage of extracted image, audio, and video resource links that are external to the page's registered domain, on a 0-to-100 scale; 0 when no media links exist.
column_descriptions.sfh: Server-form-handler indicator equal to 1 when the page contains a form with a null action and 0 otherwise. This feature is zero for every row in the processed table.
column_descriptions.iframe: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the fetched page contains an invisible iframe and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.popup_window: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the page text contains a prompt-based pop-up script and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.safe_anchor: Percentage of anchor tags classified as unsafe because their destination uses '#', JavaScript, mailto, or another source-defined unsafe form, on a 0-to-100 scale; 0 when no anchors exist. Despite its name, larger values mean more unsafe anchors.
column_descriptions.onmouseover: Binary indicator equal to 1 when page script uses an onmouseover handler to alter the browser status text and 0 otherwise.
column_descriptions.right_clic: Binary indicator equal to 1 when page script checks event.button == 2, a pattern used to disable right-clicking, and 0 otherwise. The truncated spelling 'clic' is inherited from the source schema.
column_descriptions.empty_title: Binary indicator equal to 1 when the fetched page has no title and 0 when a title is present.
column_descriptions.domain_in_title: Inverted domain-title indicator from the source extractor: 0 when the URL's registered-domain label appears in the page title and 1 when it does not.
column_descriptions.domain_with_copyright: Inverted copyright-domain indicator: 0 when the URL's registered-domain label appears near a copyright, trademark, or registered symbol, and 1 when such a symbol is found without the domain. The extractor also returns 0 when no symbol can be parsed.
column_descriptions.whois_registered_domain: Inverted WHOIS indicator: 0 when a returned WHOIS domain name matches the queried domain and 1 when it does not match or the WHOIS lookup fails.
column_descriptions.domain_registration_length: Absolute number of days from the extraction date to the domain's WHOIS expiration date; 0 when WHOIS has no expiration date and -1 when the lookup fails.
column_descriptions.domain_age: Domain age in days returned by the source's external domain-age service. Negative values are service-returned values or failure/missing-result sentinels.
column_descriptions.web_traffic: Alexa reach rank returned for the URL at extraction time; smaller positive ranks indicate more traffic, while 0 means the rank lookup was unavailable.
column_descriptions.dns_record: Inverted DNS indicator: 0 when the domain has at least one nameserver record and 1 when no nameserver is returned or the lookup fails.
column_descriptions.google_index: Inverted Google-index indicator: 0 when a site-restricted Google query finds the page and 1 when it does not or the result cannot be parsed.
column_descriptions.page_rank: OpenPageRank integer score for the domain on a 0-to-10 scale, with larger values indicating a more prominent domain.
column_descriptions.status: Binary classification target with string values 'legitimate' and 'phishing'. The processed table is exactly balanced between the two classes.
